author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕೆಲಸದಲಿ ಮೊದಲಸಲ ತಪ್ಪಿದರೆ ಕ್ಷಮೆಯಿಹುದು
ಹಲವುಸಲ ತಪ್ಪಿರಲು ಅಪರಾಧವಹುದು
ಬಲವದುವೆ ನಿನತಪ್ಪು ನೀನರಿತು ತಿದ್ದುತಿರೆ
ಗೆಲುದನಿಯು ತುಂಬುವುದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: A mistake at work the first time can be forgiven;
made many times over, it becomes an offence;
it is a strength if you recognise and correct your mistake;
the voice of victory will fill you, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A first mistake is forgivable; repeating it is not. Recognising and correcting our errors is itself a strength that leads to success.
